subject.title: [Feature]: Require viable inference before onboarding skips setup

question: Should automatic onboarding require a successful live inference check for imported default models and enforce a 16K effective-context minimum for automatic Ollama/LM Studio selection?
rationale: The requested behavior deliberately changes first-run routing and defines an ecosystem-wide automatic-selection threshold; source-level implementation cannot determine the intended product policy or exception boundary alone.

options.title: Sponsor conservative gating
options.body: Require live verification for import-supplied defaults and retain manual setup for models that fail verification or automatic eligibility.

options.title: Keep current automatic selection
options.body: Preserve the existing fast path and treat failed first inference as a post-onboarding recovery case.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Approve import verification now while deferring the local-model context threshold until provider metadata semantics are agreed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor conservative gating
recommendation.body: Require live verification for import-supplied defaults and retain manual setup for models that fail verification or automatic eligibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue author supplied the proposed boundary and intends to implement it, making them the best available routing candidate for the product decision.
